metadata.name: sinbazaar
metadata.description: SINBAZAAR - a private real-time market where the underlying asset is a secret

instructions.name: callback_resolve
docs: The court delivers.
`#[vrf_callback]` injects a `vrf_program_identity` signer constrained to
`scoped_vrf_identity(&crate::ID)`, a PDA only the VRF program can sign for —
so no user transaction can forge a verdict.
The callback only records randomness and picks the outcome *class*. Which
specific villager wins is derived deterministically from that randomness in
`settle_bid`, which keeps this instruction small and its account list fixed.

accounts.name: vrf_program_identity
docs: Scoped VRF identity PDA, bound to this program. Its presence as a signer proves
the callback was issued by the VRF program for this program.

instructions.name: claim_author
docs: Pay the author whatever the village forfeited to them, from the settled
(undelegated) market PDA.

instructions.name: close_book
docs: Mark the market fully settled once every bid has been closed.

instructions.name: commit_market
docs: Manual commit of live market state to Solana without ending the market.

instructions.name: create_market
docs: Create the public half of a market: id, room, timer, pots, status.
The market PDA is pre-funded so that once it reaches the ER it can sponsor
its own permission, the secret's permission, and every bid's ephemeral
account — none of which the bidders should have to pay for.

instructions.name: create_secret_shell
docs: Allocate the secret account **empty**.
This is the whole privacy trick: the account is created on L1 with a zeroed
body, delegated to the TEE, and only then filled in by `seal_secret` on the
ER. No confession byte is ever submitted in a base-layer transaction, so
there is no block, log, or explorer view in which it could appear.

instructions.name: delegate_market
docs: Delegate the market to the ER so bidding is real-time.

instructions.name: delegate_purse
docs: Delegate the purse so its lamports can move at ER speed.

instructions.name: delegate_secret
docs: Delegate the (still empty) secret to the TEE validator.

accounts.name: market
docs: owned by the delegation program and cannot be deserialized here. Only its
address is needed, and the seeds constraint pins that.

instructions.name: deposit_purse
docs: Fund a villager's purse with real SOL on the base layer.

instructions.name: expire_market
docs: Close the book. Permissionless: anyone may crank this once the timer is up,
so a market cannot be held open by an absent author.

instructions.name: finalize_market
docs: The last act on the rollup.
If — and only if — the verdict authorises text, copy it out of the private
secret into the market's public reveal buffer. Then commit and undelegate
the market so Solana receives the tombstone. The secret is never undelegated:
a buried confession stays inside the TEE for good.

instructions.name: fund_bid
docs: Move the money for a bid that `place_bid` just opened.
Lamports go purse -> market between two program-owned delegated PDAs, so
there is no base-layer transaction and no wallet round trip. Sent in the
same transaction as `place_bid`; see that instruction for why they are split.

instructions.name: grant_reader
docs: Grant the VRF-selected reader membership of the secret's private permission.
This is the moment the randomness becomes real: one key, and only one, gains
the ability to decrypt-by-authorisation. The author stays a member.

instructions.name: init_bid_permission
docs: Hide the bid behind a private permission listing only the bidder.

instructions.name: init_market_permission
docs: The market's permission is deliberately PUBLIC. Hash, timer, pots and
status are supposed to be readable by anyone; that is the market.

instructions.name: init_secret_permission
docs: The secret's permission. PRIVATE for confession rooms — member list is
`[author]`, so no other key can read the body over any RPC, TEE endpoint
included. Whisper IPO passes `is_private = false` because a rumor is meant
to be read; it is the positions that stay hidden.

instructions.name: initialize_village
docs: Open the village. Fiction mode is on by default and is a product-level
declaration, not a security control.

instructions.name: open_session
docs: Mint a scoped session key so a villager can bid repeatedly without a wallet
popup per click. Scope is a single market, a spend ceiling, and an expiry —
all enforced by the program, not by the client.

instructions.name: place_bid
docs: Open a bid. Runs entirely on the ER, signed by the villager's own wallet.
This instruction only *creates and records* the bid; `fund_bid` moves the
money. They are deliberately separate instructions sent in ONE transaction:
creating an ephemeral account is a CPI to the magic program, and keeping the
program's own lamport arithmetic in its own instruction makes each
instruction's balance trivially auditable. The transaction stays atomic, so
a bid is still opened and funded together or not at all.
A bid that is created but never funded counts for nothing: it stays
`funded = false`, contributes to no pot, and settles for zero.

accounts.name: signer
docs: The villager, signing for themselves.

accounts.name: bidder
docs: the bid PDA from the same seeds.

instructions.name: place_bid_with_session
docs: The same bid, signed by a scoped session key instead of the wallet.
A separate instruction rather than an optional account, because the session
scope has to be *written* (to charge the bid against its ceiling) and the ER
rejects a writable account that is not delegated — so the wallet-signed path
must not carry a writable session account it never uses.

accounts.name: signer
docs: The session key the villager's wallet authorised.

accounts.name: session
docs: Writable because the bid is charged against its spend ceiling.

instructions.name: request_resolution_vrf
docs: Ask MagicBlock VRF for the randomness that decides this market.
Requested from the ER against the ephemeral queue, so the request and the
callback both land at rollup speed while the market is still delegated.

instructions.name: resolve_rumor
docs: Whisper IPO settlement.
Week-1 uses a village-authority attestation. The signature check is the only
thing that would change to swap in an oracle: the payout path below reads
`rumor_result` and nothing else.

instructions.name: retry_vrf
docs: Release a market whose randomness never arrived.
Permissionless, and only after a grace period, so a stalled oracle cannot
strand escrow. It puts the market back to `Expired` where anyone can request
randomness again — it never decides an outcome itself.

instructions.name: revoke_session
docs: Revoke a session key immediately.

instructions.name: seal_secret
docs: Write the confession into the TEE.
Runs on the ER only. `commitment_hash = sha256(body || salt)` is published
to the public market so any later reveal is verifiable, while the body and
the salt never leave the private account.

instructions.name: settle_bid
docs: Settle one bid: pay it, refund it, or forfeit it, then close the ephemeral
account and its permission.
Permissionless — anyone can crank it — because the destination is pinned to
the bidder's own purse and the arithmetic is fixed by the recorded outcome.

instructions.name: undelegate_purse
docs: Return a purse to the base layer so its owner can withdraw real SOL.

instructions.name: withdraw_purse
docs: Withdraw from an undelegated purse back to the wallet.

instructions.name: write_tombstone
docs: Carve the verdict into the graveyard on Solana.
Runs on the base layer against the committed, undelegated market. Plaintext
is copied out of `market.revealed`, which `finalize_market` only ever fills
when `outcome.reveals_text()` is true.

types.name: Bid
docs: A bid. Created as an ER-only ephemeral account, sponsored by the market PDA,
and gated by a private permission listing only the bidder — so the amount and
the side stay hidden from everyone, the author included.

fields.name: index
docs: Arrival order across all bids on this market.

fields.name: read_rank
docs: Arrival order among READ bids only. Lets any cranker derive the VRF-selected
reader without holding every bid account in one transaction.

fields.name: funded
docs: Set by `fund_bid`. An unfunded bid holds no money and settles for zero.

types.name: Market
docs: Public market state. Delegated to the ER so bidding is real-time, but its
ephemeral permission is deliberately NON-private: hash, timer, pots and status
are meant to be readable by anyone. The body never lives here.

fields.name: commitment_hash
docs: sha256(body || salt) — published at creation, verifiable after any reveal.

fields.name: yes_pot
docs: Whisper IPO books.

fields.name: ransom_floor
docs: Blackmail escrow ransom curve: floor + slope * seconds_elapsed.

fields.name: sole_reader
docs: Set by the VRF callback for SoleReader / Inherited outcomes.

fields.name: randomness
docs: Raw randomness the oracle delivered, kept for auditability.

fields.name: escrow_lamports
docs: Lamports this PDA holds on behalf of bidders (excludes rent + sponsor float).

fields.name: author_payout
docs: Forfeited stakes owed to the author, claimable on L1 after settlement.

fields.name: rumor_result
docs: Whisper IPO attested result: 0 unresolved, 1 YES, 2 NO.

fields.name: revealed_len
docs: Reveal buffer. Stays all-zero unless `outcome.reveals_text()`. Filled on the
ER at finalize time by copying out of the private `Secret`, immediately
before the market is committed to L1 — so plaintext reaches the base layer
only when the verdict authorised it.

types.name: Outcome
docs: The verdict of the village. Written on-chain and carved into the L1 tombstone.

types.name: Purse
docs: A villager's spending purse. Funded with real SOL on the base layer, then
delegated to the ER so every bid is an ER-native lamport move with no wallet
round trip and no base-layer transaction per click.

fields.name: available
docs: Lamports available to bid, tracked separately from the account's rent.

fields.name: locked
docs: Lamports currently locked in open bids.

types.name: Room
docs: Which room of the bazaar a market belongs to.
The first four are LIVE. Everything after `MirrorConfession` is typed into the
program deliberately but rejected by `create_market` — they are Phase 7 rooms
shown as disabled cards in the UI, not half-built code paths.

types.name: Secret
docs: The confession itself. Delegated to the TEE validator and gated by an ephemeral
permission whose member list starts as `[author]`.
For confession rooms the permission is PRIVATE, so the body is unreadable over
any RPC by anyone but the author. For Whisper IPO the same account holds the
rumor headline with a PUBLIC permission — the rumor is meant to be read; it is
the positions that stay hidden. Nothing here is ever copied to the base layer
unless `Outcome::reveals_text()`.

fields.name: redacted_len
docs: Author-supplied single sentence, the only thing a RandomReveal may publish.

types.name: Tombstone
docs: The graveyard entry. Written on the BASE layer after settlement and never
deleted. Carries plaintext only when the outcome authorised it.

types.name: Village
docs: The village: one per authority, lives on the base layer, never delegated.

fields.name: fiction_mode
docs: Fiction mode is ON by default. Seeded content is startup-village satire only.
